treats.name: Buckeyes
treats.description: Smooth, creamy peanut butter centers hand-rolled and dipped in rich, premium chocolate, finished with the signature chocolate “eye.” A classic sweet-to-cocoa balance with a soft, timeless bite.

treats.name: Nellas
treats.description: Chocolate sandwich cookie topped with a creamy peanut butter layer, dipped in smooth premium chocolate for a rich, balanced bite that blends crunch, cream, and cocoa.

treats.name: Nonpareils
treats.description: Smooth chocolate discs hand-dropped and topped with classic candy beads for a simple, snappy, melt-away chocolate bite.

treats.name: 3 Pack Vanilla Wafers
treats.description: Light, crispy vanilla wafer cookie hand-dipped in smooth chocolate for a clean, classic crunch with a silky melt.

treats.name: Or-E-Os
treats.description: Classic chocolate sandwich cookies hand-dipped in smooth, premium chocolate for an elevated crunch-meets-cream bite that feels indulgent, familiar, and unforgettable.

treats.name: "Mini" Peanut Butter Puddles
treats.description: Sweet E's signature creamy peanut butter hand-dropped on a buttery Ritz cracker and dipped in smooth chocolate with a splash of crushed peanut on top for a rich, crunch yet soft-set confection with a small-batch homemade look.

treats.name: Turtles (Pecan OR Cashew)
treats.description: Turtles combines rich, creamy caramel, crunchy pecans OR cashew, and smooth chocolate for a delightful treat. Perfect for satisfying your sweet cravings or gifting to someone special.

treats.name: Gummy Bears
treats.description: Soft, fruit-flavored gummy candy hand-dipped in smooth chocolate for a playful, sweet, chewy-meets-melt bite.

treats.name: Sea Salt Caramels
treats.description: Soft, rich caramel squares hand-dipped in smooth chocolate and finished with a light sprinkle of sea salt for a balanced sweet-meets-salt bite.

treats.name: Kissed Cookie
treats.description: Soft-baked chocolate chip cookie hand-dipped in smooth premium chocolate, topped with a chocolate chip crown.

treats.name: Graham Cracker
treats.description: Crisp honey graham cracker hand-dipped in smooth, premium chocolate for a clean snap, balanced sweetness, and classic chocolate crunch.

treats.name: Malted Milk Balls
treats.description: Crunchy malted milk centers hand-coated in smooth, premium chocolate for a classic candy crunch with a rich melt.

treats.name: 2 Pack Large Pretzel Rods
treats.description: Crunchy large style pretzel rods hand-dipped in smooth, premium chocolate for a classic salty-crunch bite with a clean chocolate melt. Available in 2 packs!

treats.name: Strawberries
treats.description: Fresh strawberries hand-dipped in smooth, premium chocolate for a bright, sweet bite with a rich, silky finish. A classic favorite made for gifting, celebrations, and dessert displays.

treats.name: Soft Caramel Gems
treats.description: Delight in the creamy texture and sweet indulgence of Soft Caramel Gems, featuring an irresistible flavor that melts in your mouth with every bite.

treats.name: Mini Rice Krispie
treats.description: Mini Rice Krispie treats deliver the perfect combination of crispy texture and sweet flavor in a convenient, portable snack. Ideal for on-the-go enjoyment or a quick treat anytime!

treats.name: Solid Flower
treats.description: A beautifully crafted solid chocolate flower available in rich milk chocolate or decadent dark chocolate.

treats.name: Solid Leaf
treats.description: Indulge in the Solid Leaf, a rich chocolate treat available in your choice of creamy milk or bold dark chocolate. Perfect for gifting or enjoying as a delightful snack.

treats.name: Solid Pineapple
treats.description: A delightful pineapple-shaped mold crafted from solid chocolate, available in your choice of rich milk or intense dark chocolate.

treats.name: Single Chocolate Wafer
treats.description: A delicate wafer coated in rich, smooth chocolate, offering a delightful balance of crispiness and sweetness in every bite.

treats.name: Single Strawberry Wafer
treats.description: Delicate layers of crispy wafer filled with a luscious strawberry cream, offering a perfect balance of sweetness and crunch with every bite.

treats.name: Bare Peanut Brittle 6oz
treats.description: Enjoy 6 ounces of homemade bare peanut brittle, crafted with crunchy peanuts and a sweet, buttery caramelized sugar base.

treats.name: Drizzled Pecan Brittle - 1LB
treats.description: Enjoy the rich, buttery crunch of Dena’s Specialty Candy Pecan Brittle recipe, crafted by Sweet Es Confections and drizzled with your choice of milk or dark chocolate. Perfectly balanced for a delightful treat in every bite!

treats.name: Bare Pecan Brittle 6oz
treats.description: Enjoy 6 ounces of homemade bare pecan brittle, crafted with crunchy pecans and a sweet, buttery caramelized sugar base.
